title: Architectural Design Decisions for Data Ingestion in Big Data Architectures
abstract: arXiv:2611.23297v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Introduction: Data ingestion is the first critical step in a data architecture, in which data from various sources is moved to storage systems, such as data lakes and data warehouses, for analysis and insight generation. When developing a data ingestion pipeline, practitioners (e.g., data engineers and architects) must understand the data ingestion requirements (functional and non-functional) and select appropriate design options to support them.   Objective: To help practitioners systematically develop data ingestion processes, this paper aims to compile a catalog of data ingestion design decisions, their options, and the selection drivers.   Method: We conducted a systematic gray literature review on data ingestion, analyzed the selected literature using qualitative data analysis methods, and conducted semi-structured interviews with experts to assess the framework's practicality and utility.   Results: From 42 gray literature articles

translated_title: 大数据架构中数据摄取的架构设计决策
translated_abstract: 引言：数据摄取是数据架构中的第一个关键步骤，在此步骤中，来自各种来源的数据被迁移到存储系统（如数据湖和数据仓库）中，用于分析和洞察生成。在开发数据摄取管道时，从业者（如数据工程师和架构师）必须理解数据摄取的需求（功能性需求和非功能性需求），并选择合适的设计选项来支持这些需求。目标：为了帮助从业者系统地开发数据摄取流程，本文旨在汇编一份关于数据摄取设计决策、其选项以及选择驱动因素的目录。方法：我们对数据摄取领域进行了系统性灰文献综述，采用定性数据分析方法对所选文献进行分析，并与专家进行了半结构化访谈，以评估该框架的实用性和效用。结果：从42篇灰文献文章中……（原文摘要至此截断）
tldr: 本文通过系统性灰文献综述、定性分析及专家访谈，编制了一份包含数据摄取设计决策、选项及选择驱动因素的目录，以帮助从业者系统地开发大数据架构中的数据摄取流程。
en_tdlr: This paper compiles a catalog of data ingestion design decisions, their options, and selection drivers through a systematic gray literature review and expert interviews, helping practitioners systematically develop data ingestion pipelines in big data architectures.
